connector.name: Postgram
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted memory for AI agents with hybrid search, knowledge graphs, tasks, and document sync.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ivo-toby account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for a database with the pgvector extension enabled.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Required only when OpenAI is selected for embeddings or extraction.

env.name: EMBEDDING_BASE_URL
env.description: Ollama embedding endpoint when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is ollama.

env.name: ADMIN_MFA_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Stable random value of at least 32 characters used to protect admin MFA seeds.

env.name: ADMIN_SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: Stable 32-byte base64url key used to encrypt provider secrets saved in the admin UI.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using a Postgram API key created with pgm-admin or the admin UI.
